description.value: The Corner Store Cafe is a neighbourhood cafe on Anderson Street in Vancouver offering vegetarian-friendly food and drinks in a smoke-free indoor setting. Wheelchair accessible and accepting both credit and debit cards, it presents a convenient urban refuelling stop for touring cyclists moving through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL points to an Instagram profile, but the fetched content returned only Instagram's generic login wall and navigation pages — no cafe-specific content was accessible. All amenity and business data therefore relies on OSM tags alone. OSM confirms vegetarian-friendly options (diet:vegetarian=yes), indoor seating, no outdoor seating, wheelchair accessibility, and card payment; no bike parking, washroom, or refill information appears in either source.
concerns: Website URL is an Instagram profile that requires login to view cafe-specific content; no business information could be extracted from the fetched pages.
Address is missing a street number — only 'Anderson Street, Vancouver' is available from OSM.
URL was discovered with medium confidence; no independent corroboration of the Instagram handle from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Appears to be a real, operating cafe in Vancouver with active OSM data and no indicators of closure; a useful food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: neighbourhood cafe on Anderson Street in Vancouver
